baseline_findings: B-EXACT-MATCH-CF: 20/40=0.500 pooled (Wilson [0.352,0.648]), binom p=1.9e-10 vs 0.10. Per-family: header 10/10, body 10/10, auth 0/10, mixed 0/10. ECE 0.237. Calibrates 0.10 binomial null as expected.
B-FLAT-TFIDF-K5-CF: 20/40=0.500 pooled (Wilson [0.352,0.648]), identical to exact-match. Per-family same pattern. ECE 0.226. Strong flat baseline for McNemar comparison.
H-HIERARCHICAL-CF: 20/40=0.500 pooled (Wilson [0.352,0.648]), identical to flat/exact. Per-family same pattern. ECE 0.226. Honest cost permutation rho=0.230 (p=0.176) marginally exceeds threshold.

B-COMPILED-DSM: 20/40=0.500 pooled (Wilson [0.352,0.648]), identical to baselines. Per-family: header 10/10, body 10/10, auth 0/10, mixed 0/10. ECE 0.219. Compilation IR manifest valid. Did NOT break bounded ceiling on synthetic data.

B-ENDPOINT-CATALOG: 20/40=0.500 pooled (Wilson [0.352,0.648]), identical to baselines. Per-family: header 10/10, mixed 0/10. ECE 0.226. Catalog manifest valid. Did NOT break bounded ceiling on synthetic data.

B-JOINT-FETCH (exploratory): 40/40=1.000 pooled (Wilson [0.912,0.912]), binom p=1e-40. Per-family: header 10/10, auth 10/10, mixed 10/10. ECE 0.110. Consistent with prior synthetic joint result (EXP-FRONTIER-35903208514: 40/40=1.0). Not validated on live heterogeneous sample.
B-RANDOM-K5-CF: 7/40=0.175 pooled (Wilson [0.087,0.320]), binom p=0.100 vs 0.10 (NS). Chance calibration as expected.

McNemar tests: All single-candidate shootout pipelines vs B-EXACT-MATCH p=1.0 (identical outcomes); vs B-FLAT p=1.0. No discriminability between compilation, endpoint, hierarchical, flat, exact on this synthetic fixture.
